status: Partial controller implementation; neither record is a completed port.
small_bomb_identity: Inferred mapping from the installed Small Bomb component; not a recovered native AI call.

819.0.0.movement: Flying pursuit with a circling tendency; local smoothing and obstacle-aware flight routes.
819.0.0.targeting: Pursues player; relative swept collision detects contact including dodge crossings.
819.0.0.attacks: Player contact immediately explodes: source half-heart player / 40 enemy damage. Normal death becomes a delayed tiny bomb: full-heart player / 100 enemy damage.
819.0.0.vulnerability: Source base HP 7; ordinary damage kills; contact takes a separate explosion branch.
819.0.0.phases: Pursuing flyer -> contact explosion OR shot death -> delayed ordnance; exactly one branch.
819.0.0.offspring: Real delayed Small Bomb ordnance, carried outside the NPC registry; 4.14.0 identity mapping is an inference.
819.0.0.completion: Dead flyer releases its room threat; bomb persists after clear and can still harm player, companions and enemies.

adaptations.movement: Local speed 3 before existing 1.1 hostile multiplier, circle range 6, strength .7, turn 4 rad/s; alternate circling direction from entity ID. Orbital radius 2, speed 1.8 rad/s. Real 3D flight and altitude/cover collision; border compression is local.
adaptations.bombs: Local fuse 1 second/radius 3; base player damage 10/20 uses existing 1.25 hostile multiplier -> 12.5/25. Enemy values remain 40/100. Vertical fall from death altitude, radius .18 bomb physics and gravity 18; no inherited player bomb items/inventory.
adaptations.lifetime: Floor-persistent ordnance pauses in inactive rooms, survives ordinary clear. Active cap 128 and pending cap 256; pending fuse starts on materialization. Beyond both limits suppression is logged. Explicit debug clear discards it.
adaptations.provenance: Hostile, companion-affecting real explosion with hard demolition; independent event source, not a fabricated area-damage hit. Generic event limits remain effective.
adaptations.ownership: Atomic full trio preflight. Body damage is rejected; owner-group helper is not a Horny Boys implementation. Orbiters do not pay independent loot/counters.
adaptations.presentation: Original rendering with procedural bomb body, wings, fuse; pink body/halo for owned variant; ground ordnance has lit fuse and radius warning. No Isaac art copied.

unknowns: Native steering speed/curve, turn rate, orbit geometry, explosion radius and fuse are not measured; configured values are local.
The tiny-bomb mapping to installed Small Bomb 4.14.0 is inferred from naming; native AI linkage has not been recovered.
Skatole/Beelzebub and other fly-item/status interactions remain unimplemented; the flattened Skatole dossier mixes edition-dependent lists and needs source-markup review.
Human play, all-camera readability, mixed-build balance and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
The Shell 19.3.0 offspring route is still missing.
